Academic Programs Through JEE (Advanced), IITs offer admission into undergraduate courses leading to a Bachelors, Integrated Masters, Bachelor-Master Dual Degree in Engineering, Sciences, or Architecture
All Indian nationals who satisfy the eligibility criteria (see Clause 11) can appear for JEE (Advanced) 2026
The details of the eligibility criteria (see Clause 11) for them are available at https://jeeadv.ac.in/foreign.html

The foreign national candidates, at the time of registering for JEE (Advanced) 2026 are NOT required to write JEE (Main) 2026 and may register for JEE (Advanced) 2026 directly subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria (for details foreign candidates may refer to Clause 11 and…
Eligibility Criteria for Appearing in JEE (Advanced) 2026
(A) Eligibility Criteria for Indian Nationals and OCI/PIO (I)5
Criterion A2 – Age limit Candidates should have been born on or after October 1, 2001
Five years age relaxation is given to SC, ST, and PwD candidates, i.e. these candidates should have been born on or after October 1, 1996

Criterion A4 – Appearance in Class XII (or equivalent) examination* A candidate should have appeared for the Class XII (or equivalent) examination for the first time in either 2025 or 2026 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects

(B) Eligibility criteria for foreign national candidates and OCI/PIO (F) Candidates who are (i) NOT citizens of India (by birth or naturalized) and (ii) OCI/PIO (F) candidates as described above (see Clause 6), shall be considered as FOREIGN NATIONALS
